item.description: - **California tribes win an order barring Kalshi sports contracts on their lands, with 21 days to report compliance steps, Prediction Market Tools reports** — Prediction Market Tools reports California tribes secured an order barring Kalshi from offering sports contracts on their lands after disputing the effectiveness of the exchange's voluntary location-blocking measures, with Kalshi ordered to report its compliance steps within 21 days. The order adds to recent setbacks including a Second Circuit decision denying Kalshi an injunction against New York and Connecticut enforcement of their gambling laws. (Prediction Market Tools)

item.title: Kalshi parlay taker losses top 1 billion dollars since the product launched in September 2025, InGame reports
item.description: - **Kalshi parlay taker losses top 1 billion dollars since the product launched in September 2025, InGame reports** — InGame analysis shows Kalshi multi-leg parlay volume has reached 165.6 billion dollars since September 2025, with taker stakes of 7.1 billion dollars and taker losses of 1.004 billion dollars, including about 400 million dollars in fees. Almost half of the taker losses have come in the eight weeks since the 2026 NFL season kicked off, while parlay market makers have made 519.8 million dollars in profit after fees. (InGame)

item.title: CFTC directs prediction market exchanges to end domestic geographic restrictions within 30 days, NJToday reports
item.description: - **CFTC directs prediction market exchanges to end domestic geographic restrictions within 30 days, NJToday reports** — The CFTC has issued an interpretation directing designated contract markets and prediction market platforms to cease domestic geographic restrictions within 30 days or explain why compliance is not feasible, citing impartial access requirements under Regulation 38.151(b). The directive leaves platforms such as Kalshi caught between federal requirements for national access and state court orders demanding regional geofencing. (NJToday)
